status.description: Whether the worktree is ready for the implementation executor.

commands.description: Ordered command attempts the setup executor made. Each entry is one command that was actually executed, in order, with the captured outcome. The successful_commands subset is the persistable setup plan when status is ready.

source.description: Where the setup executor took this command from. `environment_setup` means a prior environment.setup command, `environment_commands` means a named environment command, `discovered` means repository signals or conventions, and `readiness_check` means a command run only to verify readiness.

successful_commands.description: The ordered subset of commands that made the worktree ready. When status is ready this is the setup plan that should be persisted to environment.yaml when the profile lacked a setup field or the learned plan differs.

inspected_files.description: Files the setup executor inspected to plan the setup, such as package manifests, lockfiles, and setup docs.

readiness_evidence.description: One or two sentences explaining why the executor concluded the worktree is ready, citing the verification it ran.

repair_guidance.description: When status is failed, concrete next steps the operator can take to repair environment.setup.

error.description: When status is failed, the terse failure summary.

provider.description: Daemon-owned provider metadata. If a setup executor emits this field, the daemon overwrites it from the resolved executor.cli before persisting setup_result.json. Prefer executor_cli when present; provider remains a CLI mirror for older evidence.

executor_cli.description: Resolved executor CLI used for this setup preflight. Reused ready evidence is valid only when the current run's resolved CLI, model, and effort match these fields.

executor_model.description: Resolved executor model used for this setup preflight. Empty string means the provider CLI default and is persisted explicitly (not omitted) so requeue reuse can distinguish an empty resolved model from missing identity fields.

executor_effort.description: Resolved executor effort used for this setup preflight. Empty string is persisted explicitly when effort is unset after resolution.

source.description: Where the setup plan came from. For ready results this identifies the canonical successful plan; for failed results it identifies the attempted plan whose failure is reported. `environment_setup` means a prior environment.setup plan, `environment_commands` means named environment commands, and `discovered` means a plan composed from repository signals or conventions.
